Metadata.description: USDC payments, API keys and webhooks for your business on GatoPago.

Errors.CANCELLED: Confirmation was cancelled on your device. You can try again.
Errors.PASSKEY_WITHOUT_PRF: This key does not work on this device. Sign in with the QR from the app, or with the key saved on your phone (iCloud or Google).
Errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: That key does not belong to a GatoPago account. Create your account in the app first.
Errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment.
Errors.NETWORK_ERROR: GatoPago cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
Errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session expired. Sign in again.
Errors.UNKNOWN: We could not complete this step. Try again.

Login.title: Sign in to GatoPago Business
Login.copy: Your charges, API keys and webhooks. You sign in with the GatoPago app: no passwords.
Login.step2: Tap Scan and point at this code.
Login.step3: Confirm with your fingerprint or face.
Login.useKeyHere: Use my key on this device
Login.firstTimeKey: First time with this key: scan the code with the GatoPago app to approve it. Next time, your fingerprint is enough.
Login.scanWithApp: Scan it with the GatoPago app
Login.waiting: Waiting for your phone · renews in {seconds} s

Overview.title: Overview
Overview.description: Get paid in USDC from any wallet or GatoPago account. The money arrives straight in your account.
Overview.nameLabel: Name your customers see when paying
Overview.arrives: Payments arrive at your GatoPago account on {network} ({address}). No custody: the money is yours from the first second.
Overview.chargeTitle: Create a charge from your server
Overview.chargeBody: It returns a checkout_url: the link or QR your customer pays.
Overview.webhookBody: Register your URL in Webhooks. When it is paid, a signed payment_intent.succeeded arrives.

Payments.title: Payments
Payments.description: The charges your server created, newest first.
Payments.empty: No charges yet. Create the first one from your server.
Payments.inPersonCopy: Show this QR to your customer or share the link.

Keys.title: API keys
Keys.description: Your server uses a key to create charges and read events. Keep it secret: anyone with it can create charges in your name.

Webhooks.title: Webhooks
Webhooks.description: GatoPago sends every event to your URLs, signed in the GatoPago-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256 with the endpoint secret). Failed deliveries are retried up to 10 times.
Webhooks.empty: No endpoints yet. Add the URL where your server listens.

Events.title: Events
Events.description: The latest 100 events of your business and how each delivery went. Open one to see what was sent.
